stage: Preparation-only engineering corrections; no model trained or selected on these data yet
unstructured_horizon: Instruction-following inspected502000rows but yielded0unambiguous complete pairs. Kept out of training; structured3efforts and curated-local pilots retained.
stack_sampling: Initial shard sample overrepresented335StackOverflow shards. Excluded that draft. Current sample uses one pinned shard per community and a750part preparation bound. squad: Initial first-alias occurrence crop superseded by exact annotated-occurrence crop; draft excluded.

tokenizer_optimization: ASCII whitespace-word lower bound rejects only provably overlength unannotated positives before WordPiece; it does not crop them. Remote Parquet handles cached to avoid repeated footers.
input_preservation: Global build preserves already-curated input strings, avoiding a second HTML cleanup that could erase literal mathematical comparisons.
local_generation: LCQA74-example pilot is separate from training; new generation queue is prepared only and no LLM service was called.
quality_spot_checks: Yahoo excluded after nonresponsive joke answers. Generic structured Horizon refusals filtered. New candidates get pinned ftfy encoding repair and safe string-list flattening; original raw hashes and answer evidence preserved. Legacy retention inputs unchanged. These spot checks are not a population quality estimate.
reference_identity_cache: Full reserved corpus texts are SHA-verified. Unique reference text identities cached as non-pickle NumPy arrays, keyed by text digests, tokenizer files, transform source and library versions. Bounded input prefixes preserve first128 BERT token IDs and avoid overflow allocations on huge documents.
cross_source_passage_group_check: 117193 distinct full-passage group identities among SQuAD-exact/NQ-recovered/Trivia-recovered; zero cross-source identity intersections. Final-file preflight also checks all train/dev source-group identities for overlap.
